decision_question: Should the exact frozen W8 candidate epoch be accepted as the technical baseline for planning the CyberAlchemy business-system bridge, Rust system-runtime ontology, context projection bindings, and integration validation?

selection.label: Accept the exact W8 epoch as the baseline for integration planning
selection.owner_gate: G-W8-ACCEPTANCE CyberAlchemy product and ontology-runtime owner gate
selection.rationale: The exact W8 candidate has a current frozen dependency graph, passing W0-W7 predecessor gates, eleven passing aggregate validations, byte-identical two-run output, empty acceptance-critical residue, and no blockers. The selected effect is limited to planning the four named integration capabilities against that immutable baseline.

considered_options.label: Accept the exact W8 epoch as the baseline for integration planning
Defer W8 acceptance and integration planning

scope: Define a candidate CyberAlchemy business-system bridge boundary and its D65 predecessors
Define a candidate system-runtime ontology boundary for the accepted Rust event-sourcing engine
Plan exact context-to-event-calculated-projection bindings against one canonical cut
Plan deterministic integration validation against the frozen accepted W8 contract
allowed_effects: read the exact accepted W8 manifest and verdict
inspect selector-level CyberAlchemy context, governance-domain, and product meaning dependencies required by the four planning scopes
author repository-local planning candidates with explicit target files, gates, validation IDs, owner routes, and claim ceilings

resolved: Whether the exact cal-w8-final-epoch-001 candidate may be used as the successor integration-planning baseline
established: Only the exact accepted_w8_epoch is the immutable technical predecessor for integration planning.
A planning candidate may decompose the four named integration scopes and define their future gates and validation surfaces.
not_established: Publication, release, deployment, credentials, destructive action, or external-effect authority

remaining_blockers.statement: No validated integration plan yet binds exact definitions, Product Capability, business ontology, DomainSpec source, target files, write scopes, validation contracts, owner routes, and staged D65 gates.
Integration admission and migration cutover remain a separate owner decision after implementation and independent validation.

deferred_decisions: The exact admission and migration cutover decision remains deferred until the integration candidate is implemented and independently validated.
claim_ceiling: This decision accepts only the exact W8 candidate as an immutable technical baseline and authorizes planning for the four named integration scopes. It does not authorize implementation, canonical definition promotion, ontology or profile admission, publication, release, deployment, migration cutover, credentials, destructive action, or external effects.
